description: A machine-readable description of an HTTP API: its paths, parameters, request and response schemas and errors.
A community library that generates the OpenAPI document for Spring Boot controllers and serves Swagger UI.
An interactive web page, served at /swagger-ui.html, that renders the OpenAPI document and can call the endpoints.
The unique name of an operation in the document, used by client generators as the method name.
The description of a request or response body, including property types, required fields and limits taken from validation annotations.
An annotation that adds a description, an example or another detail to a record component in the document.
The committed OpenAPI file that back end and front end both rely on, so a breaking change shows up as a diff.
